annotations.coverageReview: Fresh six-view survey, native front/side frames and all three overlay versions inspected. Frost Lynx has one head. Initial lower chin and jaw samples reached the scarf boundary and were replaced with higher facial picks. Final lower muzzle and cheek/jaw radii .07/.09 remain on cyan facial anatomy; minimum battle patch 30 vertices. Body, tail, scarf and all animation/technique coverage remain pending.

review.name: Frost Lynx
findings: Raw source/battle face and body review passes. Actual Water Strike and Open Wound windup expose toe-floor penetration.

Seven lower-body tracks coordinate root translation and both leg chains in attack/cast/recoil. Both feet remain supported during actual techniques. Four regression tests verify contacts between keys and unchanged geometry, skin, bind rig and every unrelated track. Candidate and final rebuilt source/battle, low/medium transitions, idle, all nine techniques and atlas were actually inspected and passed.

companionTechniqueAudit.label: independent-legendary-012-supported-v1-final-techniques
companionTechniqueAudit.finding: All nine equipped techniques, twelve phases and both views actually inspected in native-pixel lossless strips. Both feet stay above the floor throughout windup, strike and recover, including the previously failed Water Strike and Open Wound samples. Head, scarf, arms, fists and tail remain coherent.
